summary.description: Xylenes are colourless, sweet-smelling flammable liquids belonging to the BTEX group, used in manufacturing chemicals, plastics, solvents, and paints.
emission_sources: Manufacturing processes involving chemicals and plastics
environmental_impact: Large exposures can harm the brain, digestive system, heart, ears, eyes, liver, lungs, skin, and throat in humans
As volatile organic compounds (VOCs), contribute to harmful ground-level ozone affecting human health and plants

top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: Xylenes at high exposure levels adversely affect multiple human organs and systems, posing significant health risks.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: Their widespread industrial use and contribution to air pollution highlight the need for sustainable production and consumption practices.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG11_Sustainable_Cities_and_Communities: As VOCs, xylenes contribute to ground-level ozone and air pollution, affecting urban air quality and community health.
